sn14.34:1.2: paṭhavīdhātu ca hidaṃ bhikkhave, ekantadukkhā abhavissa dukkhānupatitā dukkhāvakkantā anavakkantā sukhena, nayidaṃ sattā paṭhavīdhātuyā sārajjeyyuṃ.
sn14.34:1.3: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave, paṭhavīdhātu sukhā sukhānupatitā sukhāvakkantā anavakkantā dukkhena, tasmā sattā paṭhavīdhātuyā sārajjanti.
sn14.34:2.3: vāyodhātu ca hidaṃ bhikkhave, ekantadukkhā abhavissa dukkhānupatitā dukkhāvakkantā anavakkantā sukhena, nayidaṃ sattā vāyodhātuyā sārajjeyyuṃ.
sn14.34:2.4: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave, vāyodhātu sukhā sukhānupatitā sukhāvakkantā anavakkantā dukkhena, tasmā sattā vāyodhātuyā sārajjanti.
sn14.34:3.1: paṭhavīdhātu ca hidaṃ bhikkhave, ekantasukhā abhavissa sukhānupatitā sukhāvakkantā anavakkantā dukkhena, nayidaṃ sattā paṭhavīdhātuyā nibbindeyyuṃ.
sn14.34:3.2: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave, paṭhavīdhātu dukkhā dukkhānupatitā. dukkhāvakkantā anavakkantā sukhena, tasmā sattā paṭhavīdhātuyā nibbindanti.
sn14.34:4.3: vāyodhātu ca hidaṃ bhikkhave, ekantasukhā abhavissa sukhānupatitā sukhāvakkantā anavakkantā dukkhena, nayidaṃ sattā vāyodhātuyā nibbindeyyuṃ.
sn14.34:4.4: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave, vāyodhātu dukkhā dukkhānupatitā dukkhāvakkantā anavakkantā sukhena, tasmā sattā vāyodhātuyā nibbindantīti.
